name: bjjgraph
description: BJJ knowledge graph and state machine

scripts.dev: while true; do cd source && npx quartz build --serve --concurrency 4 -d ../content; echo 'Dev server crashed. Restarting in 5 seconds'; for i in 5 4 3 2 1; do printf '. '; sleep 1; done; echo; cd ..; done
scripts.regenerate: npm run regenerate:issues && npm run regenerate:json && npm run regenerate:explode && npm run regenerate:md && npm run regenerate:hubs && npm run regenerate:votes && npm run regenerate:graph
scripts.regenerate:build: npm run regenerate && npm run build
